name: custom-cliq
description: Unified build, dev, and run scripts for CustomCliq NFC & QR Code SaaS platform

scripts.install-all: npm run install:server && npm run install:client
scripts.build: npm run install:client && npm run build:client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold" "npm start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
